messages:
Sam (Acme): hey team — starting ~09:12 UTC we see a spike of 503s and then long timeouts against your hosted /v1/generate endpoint. Happens from our prod service, ~60 requests/s. Sample curl below. Can you advise?
Maya (Support): sorry you're seeing that, we're looking. can you paste the failing response body and approx timestamps? also are you using the official SDK retry logic or custom?
Sam (Acme): response headers show HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable, no JSON body. Example curl we used:
```
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-1","input":"hello","max_tokens":32}'
```
All errors between 2025-11-04T09:12:10Z and 09:21:30Z; spikes roughly every 30s. We also saw client-side retries (SDK default).
Maya (Support): thanks — escalating to SRE and Eng oncall. @Omar @Priya can you take a look? I suspect either downstream capacity or LB flapping.
support-bot: incident-note: ticket escalated to eng-sre at 2025-11-04T09:22:05Z
Omar (SRE): looking at ingress metrics now. I'm seeing increased 5xx from gateway pool in us-west-2 starting 09:11:30Z, correlates with a surge in connection resets. Can you confirm you're routed to us-west-2?
Sam (Acme): yes, our requests go to us-west-2. We were also getting a lot of SDK retries — default exponential backoff. Could our retries be amplifying things?
Priya (Eng): possible. two hypotheses: (1) upstream autoscaler briefly couldn't scale warm instances for concurrent KV cache misses -> returning 503s, (2) client retry tight-loop caused request amplification. Can you repro with a single client and no retries?
Sam (Acme): repro steps (minimal):
```
# disable SDK retries in python
from redwood import Redwood
c = Redwood(api_key="sk_...")
resp = c.generate({"model":"gpt-redwood-1","input":"test"}, retries=0, timeout=10)
print(resp.status_code)
```
We did that and still saw occasional 503, but much fewer.
Maya (Support): useful. Omar, Priya — any immediate mitigation? We need something to tell the customer.
Omar (SRE): rolling a routing tweak to avoid a problematic gateway node group — patching now. also increasing API ingress timeout from 10s -> 20s for that pool as a temporary mitigation. will monitor.
Priya (Eng): adding a rate-limiter on internal retry queue to prevent retry storms from queuing at the edge. timeline: hotfix in ~25m.
support-bot: deploy-bot: rolling update to ingress-pool-a started by Omar at 2025-11-04T09:38:12Z
Sam (Acme): thanks. any recommendations for client-side config?
Maya (Support): suggest setting SDK retries=2, base_backoff=0.5s, max_backoff=8s, and jitter. Also set per-request timeout to 20s to match temporary server timeout.
Sam (Acme): implemented those changes; monitoring. Initial results: error rate dropped ~80% in first 10m.
Omar (SRE): ingress hotfix finished at 09:56Z; latency and 5xx metrics returning to baseline. I can share grafana links if helpful.
Priya (Eng): follow-up: we traced root cause to a KV-cache miss storm when a few nodes were recycled during a scaling event; combined with client retries caused transient overload on warmup path. Short-term mitigation: routing tweak + larger warm pool. Long-term: improving cold-start paths and adding better backpressure.
Maya (Support): proposed customer message draft: "We identified transient capacity and retry amplification as cause of 5xxs on 2025-11-04. We've applied routing and ingress timeout mitigations and recommend small SDK retry/backoff changes. Please confirm if your service is healthy and we'll keep this ticket open for 48 hours for verification." Thoughts?
Sam (Acme): that sounds good. we'll keep an eye and report if anything recurs. thanks for fast response. :thumbsup:
Priya (Eng): we'll follow up with a post-incident note and recommended SDK defaults in docs (explicit jitter + conservative max_retries by default).
Omar (SRE): closing note: monitoring for 24h; if we see >1% 5xx again we'll open an internal incident and trigger rollback options.
Maya (Support): thanks everyone — closing on customer side once Sam confirms stable for 48h.
Sam (Acme): confirmed stable at 2025-11-04T11:00:20Z, will reopen if needed.
